newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials and techs slide, NYSE sets curbs.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials and techs slide, NYSE sets curbs.

text.p: U.S. stocks tumbled on Friday, dragged down by technology stocks amid profit-taking, several earnings disappointments and a weak bond market.

The Dow Jones industrial average, which this week closed at all-time highs, shed around 81 points or one percent, to trade at 7940. The New York Stock Exchange set curbs on index-arbitrage trading at 1006 EDT/1406 GMT.
The Nasdaq composite, whose tech stocks had recently given power to the broader markets' rise, lost 25 points to 1544. Microsoft Corp fell after reporting results.
The long bond slid 14/32 to yield 6.52 percent.
